m1_census.definition: registry key rows per ledger plus public commands and environments; kernel is one-in-one-out and the total never rises between shrink sessions

m2_parser_paths.definition: public leaf keys installed by the TeX parsers; an increase requires an Extension-gate citation

m3_escape_usage.definition: occurrences of escape-ledger spellings in the demand corpus; every occurrence names a core-grammar gap

m4_lines_per_case.definition: mean non-comment non-blank lines over the frozen 130 benchmark cases; the fidelity meter against fake shrink

m5_aliases.definition: key and value alias rows plus sunset compliance; near zero at the 1.0 freeze

m6_overloads.definition: names with several value types + union types + enum words shared across enums; must never rise
